# braze.com/product/creative-studio

Captured 2026-09-02 from `https://www.braze.com/product/creative-studio` (HTTP 200).
**Grade: `claimed`** — a marketing product page.

## What the page is

- `<h1>` reads **"Scale connection with Creative Studio"**.
- The name sits in the site's **top-level product navigation**, listed alongside
  BrazeAI Decisioning Studio, BrazeAI Agents, Cross-Channel Messaging, Journey
  Orchestration and Reporting.
- A localised copy exists at `/ja/product/creative-studio`, and a launch article at
  `/resources/articles/braze-creative-studio-launch` (also in Japanese).

## What the documentation corpus says

In 1,352 captured documentation pages, "Creative Studio" appears in **four files and is
the subject of none** — zero pages meet the focused-page threshold used everywhere else
in this analysis (the term appearing five or more times in the body).

Where it does appear, it is a **partner category label**, not a Braze capability:

    sources/docs/docs__partners__message_personalization.md:18   "## Categories  - Creative Studio"
    sources/docs/docs__releases__2026__3_5_26.md:122             "### Canva - Message Personalization - Creative Studio"
    sources/docs/docs__releases__2026__3_5_26.md:130             "### Figma - Message Personalization - Creative Studio"

So in the documentation the phrase names a shelf that third-party integrations (Canva,
Figma) sit on. On the marketing site it names a Braze product.

## The date that keeps this fair

The only dated documentation reference is the release note of **5 March 2026** — about six
months before capture. A six-month-old product with no focused documentation is
unremarkable on its own; what is not unremarkable is that it already has top-level product
navigation and a translated marketing page. Recorded as **C-12**.
